Apple.verdict: Pass as a clear 2D explanatory schematic. The organic canopy, tapered trunk and roots improve on the oval-and-dots icon. Three labels explain grafting without clutter. It is still a schematic rather than semi-realistic editorial art; at 360px the embedded labels are small, while the caption remains readable.
Apple.method: Primary agent inspected the rendered article in the in-app browser at the normal viewport and 360px width, and checked the supporting source paragraphs. This is an editorial judgment, not a botanical expert certification.

earlierReview.reason: Rejected for insufficient visual polish: one oval canopy, dots for apples, rectangular trunk. Requested believable foliage masses, branching, material shading and tapered roots.

remainingImprovements: A raster illustration path is needed to evaluate the requested semi-realistic 3D style.
An image viewer or responsive external labels would improve narrow-screen reading.

Utility pole.verdict: Pass as a restrained engineering schematic. Supply space, worker safety zone and communications cables are clearly separated, with short labels and a matching caption. Material shading gives the pole volume. The wire stubs are intentionally schematic; this is not a construction drawing or a universal pole layout. A narrow-screen check lowered the initial 18/20 grade to 17/20 because embedded labels become small at 360px, although the caption remains readable.
Utility pole.method: Primary agent inspected the rendered article in the in-app browser at the normal viewport and 360px width, and checked the broad vertical relationships against the source paragraphs. This is an editorial judgment, not an electrical engineering safety review.
remainingImprovements: Continuous perspective-consistent cable spans would look more natural than short stubs.
Raster and online asset paths are not tested.
